source: USDA Agriculture Handbook 102, Food Yields Summarized by Different Stages of Preparation
unit: weight after preparation as a fraction of weight before
method: Rendered at 300 DPI and read with word-level coordinates. Numeric columns are found by clustering x positions; the yield column is identified by page geometry rather than by text order, and is confirmed by checking that yield and loss sum to about 100. Rows failing that check are rejected, because a plausible number in the wrong column is worse than no number.

coverage.excluded: 73-131: the item-number column is misread on those pages, so rows cannot be reliably attributed

caveat: PARTIAL — pages 20–72 of 131. Only rows whose yield was confirmed against the loss column are included. Later pages were extracted but excluded: their item numbers could not be read reliably, and a yield attributed to the wrong item is worse than a missing one. A missing item number means the row was not verifiable, never that its yield is 1.0.
